utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: Please keep the previous estimates available. We need to compare the figures before making any final commitment.

utterances.speaker: K
utterances.text: The access review will continue next week. I will check the missing entries and bring a complete list to our next session.

utterances.speaker: E
utterances.text: Les documents sont encore provisoires. Nous allons relire les observations et distinguer les propositions des engagements confirmés.

utterances.speaker: D
utterances.text: We should also record the unanswered questions. No payment has been approved and the budget remains under discussion.

utterances.speaker: K
utterances.text: I agree that the records need another review. We will keep the archive intact and only export the access log.
